statements.text: Wren, Oda and Pim are shown with their HP and MP as current out of max (Wren 42/50 HP and 6/10 MP).
Wren is shown as poisoned, and no one else is.
Oda is marked as the one whose turn it is, and Wren and Pim are not.
The Bog Rat and the Marsh Wisp are shown by name with how hurt they are, and neither's HP is written as a number.
Pim, at 0 HP, is still shown with the party and is marked as fallen in words or a symbol, not only by colour or by being greyed out.
On the phone, all three members' names and HP are on screen and readable, with nothing overlapping or cut off.
